newsitem.title: USA: Staples, Office Depot sign agreement to sell stores.
newsitem.headline: Staples, Office Depot sign agreement to sell stores.

text.p: Staples Inc. and Office Depot Inc. said Wednesday they signed a definitive agreement to sell 63 business supply superstores to OfficeMax Inc., an attempt to make their merger acceptable to federal antitrust regulators.
Staples and Office Depot also said they would postpone special shareholder meetings to be held on the merger from March 31 to April 28.
Westborough, Mass.-based Staples signed a deal to buy Delray Beach, Fla.-based Office Depot for about $4 billion in stock last September.

But the Federal Trade Commission voted against the deal earlier this month. Staples and Office Depot subsequently amended the deal to divest the 63 stores to the third player in the field, OfficeMax of Shaker Heights, Ohio.
Staples will hold its shareholder meeting in Boston and Office Depot will hold its meeting at its corporate offices.
